The in-shot grade ramp of act 2 fits S03's 48 s allocation and has room to finish by the S04 landing heap (color_script: 'reach the full dream grade by the landing heap').

silent_stretches.rule: Narration is off. Every dialogue-free stretch must tell its story in picture and diegetic sound. Verdicts: carried / carried_with_conditions / not_carried.

items.span: S01 after LN-002 → S02 → S03 up to LN-003 (≈18 s → ≈100 s)
items.why: The chase is clear goal-driven action: rabbit, pursuit, burrow, fall. One beat cannot be read in picture: the daisy-chain calculation ('whether the pleasure of making a daisy-chain would be worth the trouble'). As staged it reads only as 'bored, drowsy'. That is enough, so play it as one gesture, not as a sequence of 'weighing' shots.
items.condition: Keep the drop-daisy moment short (trim T1). The dream onset must come from the sound drain in S02 and the colour ramp in S03, because no title card is allowed.

items.span: S05 whole scene + S06 opening (≈162 s → ≈229 s)
items.why: Each beat is a clear physical problem and attempt: locked doors, key, too small, curtain, little door, garden, head too big. The goal (the garden) is shown on screen, not thought. Main risk is monotony, not clarity, so compress the door-rattling (T2).
items.condition: The garden glimpse needs a POV through the passage and a return shot of Alice's face (≈12 s).

items.why: Source cause 'How can I have done that? … it's the fan' is a thought (ch002-p14). Only the picture can show that the fan makes her shrink.
items.condition: shot-planning: 1) an insert of the fan still waving while the table visibly rises past her; 2) shrinking stops the instant the fan leaves her hand. Without both, 'flings the fan away just in time' makes no sense.

items.why: Clear run, shut door, key out of reach, stamp, slip.

not_carried.line: LN-ep01-029 “And in that case I can go back by railway.”
not_carried.problem: In the source this line answers an unspoken thought ('her first idea was that she had somehow fallen into the sea', ch002-p16). The adaptation note drops that thought, so 'in that case' points at nothing on screen. She has just come up in what looks like water in a hall, and the viewer can't infer 'the sea'. With narration off, the line reads as a non sequitur.
not_carried.recommendation: Route via orchestrator to 01-story/screenplay / dialogue-rewrite (not edited here). Either (a) add a spoken lead-in taken from the source, e.g. CHAR-alice: “I must have fallen into the sea!” (~2 s; S10 → 40 s, total 539 s), or (b) cut LN-029 and let the licked-salt beat carry the 'sea' idea (−4 s, total 533 s). Either way, the total stays within budget.

trim_suggestions.how: Shorter establishing (one wide + one push-in, not three angles); daisy beat as a single pick-and-drop gesture.
Door-rattling as one tracking pass along 3-4 doors, not a full circuit of both walls; the key-in-every-lock attempts collapse into two tries and a cut.
One running shot and one reverse at the hedge; burrow entry in two shots.
Tighten the tunnel crawl before the drop.
Landing and 'jumps to her feet' in one shot.
Finishing the cake in one shot with crumbs brushed off.
Run to the door and discover it shut in one move; no second look back.
CONTINGENCY, only if Phase 6 Σ shots runs over: two slide-down attempts instead of three ('Again. Again.').
CONTINGENCY / clarity: cut LN-029 railway line (see silent_stretches.not_carried).
trim_suggestions.risk: medium (removes a period-flavour line, the 'sea' idea is then carried only by salt)

downstream_notes.shot-planning: Scene alloc_s is the Σ-shot basis (±10% per episode). S08 must keep ≥100 s. For oh-3, 'who in the world am I?' must end cleanly inside one shot. See the fan→shrink condition in silent_stretches. Every scene fits the dialogue ≤ 0.7 × time rule.
downstream_notes.edit: HOOK-OPEN is a 3 s lift from the S03 slow-fall wide, hard-cut into S01. Cut to black at the end on the ec-2 wake; the splash plays over black.
downstream_notes.music: Suggested BGM windows (keeps coverage near 40%): S03 fall (86-134 s); S05 from the curtain to the garden glimpse (≈190-224 s); S07 rise (≈320-345 s); S08 from LN-026 to the narrow escape (≈440-477 s); S10 cliffhanger tail (≈525-537 s). Leave S01, S02, S04, S06 dialogue and the S08 recitation dry.
downstream_notes.director: The curve peaks at S08 and needs S09 as a real breather before S10. Do not cut S09 below ≈20 s.
